page.layout: One page of text, single column, running head at top; a woodcut ornament with the word TYPVS beside it in the lower middle; no notes in the margins.

main_text.p: ab æterno sunt electi, & conseruantur semper, illos riecesse est in tempore efficaciter vocari, iustificari, &c. At quidam homines, &c. E. quidam homines, &c. Apparet ergo duplicem esse in omni regressu processum, quorum prior est Syllogismus demonstratiuus ὅτι; alter διότι. Hæc est Demonstrationis doctrina præclara sane & vtilis, quam ita tradidi, vt sperem & plenam esse atque integram, & facilem simul ac perspicuam.

page.notes: The lower half of the page, below the woodcut, is blank apart from show-through from the reverse; the word TYPVS is a printed signature-like word set beside the ornament and is given as a foot line. Greek words ὅτι and διότι are as printed, the first with a superscript mark, the second partly obscured.
